metrics.label: Long-Term Debt
metrics.note: PulteGroup's balance sheet carries its debt as a single 'Notes payable' line (us-gaap:NotesPayable) from FY2021 -- $1,631,098 thousand at FY2025, $1,618,586 thousand at FY2024. Before FY2021 the same line was captioned 'Senior notes' and tagged us-gaap:SeniorNotes, which is the fallback bind. The shared vocabulary cannot reach this: us-gaap:NotesPayable is a screen-only component there, and the generic us-gaap:LongTermDebt tag (a $31-77M 'Other notes payable' partial from FY2021) outranks the SeniorNotes gap-fill, so the shared path read the partial as the total. Scoped here instead, following the CarMart precedent (see CRMT.json). Financial Services debt (phm:FinancialServicesDebt, ~$0.5B) is a separate balance-sheet line and is not included, consistent with the pre-2021 SeniorNotes-only series.

note: One override, for debt. PulteGroup's total debt read as the generic us-gaap:LongTermDebt tag alone ($31-77M from FY2021) because that tag outranks the shared vocabulary's SeniorNotes gap-fill -- but the generic tag is only the small 'Other notes payable' line. The balance sheet's actual debt line is 'Notes payable' (us-gaap:NotesPayable, $1.6-2.0B) from FY2021; before that it was captioned 'Senior notes' (us-gaap:SeniorNotes). The 2024 10-K confirms: Notes payable $1,618,586 thousand on the face balance sheet, versus Senior notes payable $1,665,504 thousand and Other notes payable $35,766 thousand at fair value in the disclosures. A blanket vocabulary fix was ruled out: us-gaap:NotesPayable is a screen-only component in the shared vocabulary and reordering the analyze list risked silently changing other filers' totals. This binding reads the rendered balance-sheet line but keeps the fix scoped to this one filer.
